acceptanceCriteria: A registered Machine packet completes an encode, transport, decode, and equality-verification round trip.
Malformed framing and incompatible transports fail deterministically.
No network access or hardware driver is required.
notes: Moved to SP-006 by the System Engineer-approved Sprint split on 2026-08-24.
Approved framing: bounded 32-bit unsigned big-endian payload length followed by exactly the declared payload bytes.
rationale: Demonstrate executable capability across the planned EP-002 layers.
